existing_features.title: Update the fill-up creation flow UI to capture total fuel cost and submit it alongside odometer and fuel added, while keeping user-facing text in English.

Compute and display "Price per liter" for each fill-up entry in the Fill-Up History list based on stored total cost divided by stored liters, with sensible formatting and graceful fallback when cost is missing.

new_feature_requests.summary: Extend the fill-up data model to store a total fuel cost value per fill-up so that price per liter can be derived.

projectName: Add price per liter to fill-ups (input, storage, and display)
